Clause-②: no (test only: no product code, accept set or served shape moves)
Responsibility: a deleted production guard on auto-migration would ship green | the pin that names the guard stages a drift the guard never sees, and asserts no warning | every production deployment that sets `autoMigrate: 'safe'`
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared: open PRs' file lists and the `pm:dispatched` claims were read at this claim. No open PR touches `sql-driver-schema-drift.test.ts`. PR #24893 (#24583, the 18.x epic's step 7b) edits `schema-drift.ts`. If it changes which ops are `safe`, the dev measures on `main` and names it; whichever lands second merges `main`.
